about: Which RedFoxOS image works best on a computer, from its PCI display devices (vendor and device id, lower-case hex without 0x). The one rule set for RedFox Hub's image picker (redfox-rollback-helper) and the download page on redfoxlabs.tech. Each display device gets the first class it matches (in order), or 'other'; then the first rule whose 'all' classes are all present and whose 'none' classes are all absent gives the answer. image null means no recommendation. hybrid marks built-in graphics next to an NVIDIA card (a laptop, usually). Test cases: tests/gpu-cases.json.

classes.note: Turing and newer: GTX 16xx, RTX 20xx and newer
Maxwell, Pascal and Volta: GTX 750, GTX 900 and GTX 10xx; NVIDIA's legacy driver
older than Maxwell (Kepler, Fermi and before): no NVIDIA driver for current systems

rules.why: an NVIDIA GTX 16xx, RTX 20xx or newer card, with built-in graphics
an NVIDIA GTX 16xx, RTX 20xx or newer card
an NVIDIA GTX 10xx, 9xx or 750 card, with built-in graphics
an older NVIDIA card (Kepler or earlier, such as the GTX 600 series and most of the 700 series), which NVIDIA's drivers no longer support, so it runs on the open-source driver built into RedFoxOS
graphics it doesn't recognise (a virtual machine?)
